srList.sentence: Genomes were queried iteratively with TBLASTN, adding newly annotated Polistes ORs to the query file, until no new OR coding regions were identified.

srList.sentence: To guide annotation of exon-intron boundaries, antennal mRNA from P. fuscatus males and females (gynes) was mapped to P. fuscatus, P. metricus, and P. dorsalis genomes using STAR (Dobin et al. 2013) and assembled into transcripts using Trinity (Haas et al. 2013) (supplementary table S2, Supplementary Material online).

srList.sentence: Predicted transcripts were aligned to genomes using BLAT.

srList.sentence: Uncertain gene models in P. metricus, P. dorsalis, P. canadensis,and P. dominula were aligned to their orthologs in P. fuscatus using Muscle version 3.8.425 with maximum four iterations (Edgar 2004), and gene models were manually adjusted.

srList.sentence: Transmembrane helices of all putatively functional ORs (>300 amino acids) were predicted using TMHMM version 2.0c (Sonnhammer et al. 1998) and Phobius version 1.01 (Kall et al. 2004).
